_comment: The settlement around the village square. EV6: every structure is a PREFAB from data/config/building_prefabs.json, composed from the Medieval Village MegaKit (docs/ASSET_LEDGER.md, D24 -- the one civilian architectural family) and placed by scripts/world/village.gd: stood on the ground by asking the world (D09), given the prefab's own colliders or one AABB box, at kit-native scale (no scale corrections -- the kit is authored in real metres, walls measured 2.0w x 3.12h). Positions are world metres on the square flat at [10,-10] (terrain_playground.json `flats`, radius 18 -- every footprint sits inside it, so no new flattening was needed). ALL TUNABLE.
_comment_layout: Grandpa's house (grandpa_house.gd, not listed here -- it owns the opening's markers and collision, but its exterior is the `farmhouse_shell` prefab from building_prefabs.json, same kit family as everything below) sits west at [-22,-16], gable front and door facing the square. The workshop anchors the square's north where the old Barn stood, its open arch bay facing south-west so the EV7 work_area cluster (anvil, workbench at ~[-5,-3]) reads as its yard; the two cottages hold the north-east and east, both fronting the square; the well marks the centre where the four dirt paths meet, on its own paved apron; the fences run along the practice-meadow path so day one is bracketed by the settlement on one side and open grass on the other. The TowerWindmill is gone, not replaced: the kit has no windmill, bible sec12's mill is water/bridge architecture, and EV5's water does not exist yet -- a mismatched second-family landmark is exactly the split-the-difference failure D24 closed (see EV6-remainder in ralph/BACKLOG.md).

structures._why: the square's centre; slightly off-axis so the square does not read as gridded
the big working building, north of the square, arch bay facing the work_area cluster
parked off the workshop's front-right corner, mid-delivery

a neighbour's house, north-east of the square, door facing the well. OF31/D39: this is Mira's, and the owner asked for the merchant to have 'a store in his house' -- so the recipe now authors wall colliders with the doorway left open and `interior: shop` (scripts/world/shop_interior.gd, attached by village.gd) puts a floor, a counter and a lamp inside it. Position and yaw unchanged; the door already faced the well.

the stone cottage, east of the square, fronting the well. R7.8: was a solid AABB brick with a painted-on door; now the recipe authors a doorway hole and `interior: cottage` (scripts/world/cottage_interior.gd) puts a room behind it. Position and yaw unchanged.
the yard edge between square and Grandpa's

canopy behind the cottage pair -- the key art frames its square with trees and the scatter's clearings hold them off by design, so the settlement's own trees are authored here. 5m+ clear of route 4's path edge and 4.9m from the nearest villager.
behind the workshop, crown just above its ridge from the square. 8m+ clear of the north-west path.

EV6-remainder: bible sec12's mill at a real crossing, on EV5's stream where it approaches the pond. West wall sits at the carve's edge so the wheel (local x -4.0) hangs over the channel and its bottom paddles meet the stream surface; grounded 'highest' because the wheel's own AABB corner is the streambed. Sited on the mill-crossing terrain flat at [-133,109] (terrain_playground.json).
structures._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation, docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2: moved from (-132,107) to (-382,514) with the rest of the pond/mill group -- see terrain_playground.json flats[4]/building_aprons.footprints[5] and vegetation.json footprints[2]/clearings[5] for the matching moves. `_why` above still describes the OLD site's [-133,109] flat by number; the flat itself moved (same offset) but the prose was not rewritten to avoid drifting from the original author's reasoning -- the mill still sits on that flat, just at its new coordinates.

structures._why: the crossing itself, just downstream of the mill's north face -- deck spans the 5m carve bank to bank (centreline x~-136.3 at z=113), yawed to sit square across the stream's local bearing. Grounded 'highest' for the same reason as the mill.
structures._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation: (-136.3,113) -> (-386.3,520), same (-250,+407) offset as the mill and the pond.

structures._why: EV6-remainder: the ranger station, on the pond route's west shoulder where the route (points [-80,85] -> [-105,115]) overlooks the water -- the first built thing between the settlement and the pond valley, watching the wilds. Door yawed east toward the path; east wall clears the path's 3m shoulder by ~0.8m at the closest point. On its own small flat at [-100,100].
structures._comment_ow5d: OW5D relocation: (-100,100) -> (-350,507) per docs/MEADOWS_MACRO_LAYOUT.md section 10.2. `yaw_deg` 75 is UNCHANGED -- the table only specifies the new position, and re-deriving the door-facing angle for the new pond-route geometry is a judgement call left to the reviewer/OW5C (which owns the pond route's actual new path polyline). Flagged, not guessed at.

structures._why: R7.9, owner-requested: an inn where the villagers can stay. West of the well, inside the village-square flat (terrain_playground.json centre [10,-10], radius 18), door facing east toward the square. RESITED from an unpushed prior lane's own [-4,-8]/95deg draft (recorded in ralph/NOTES.md's R7.9 entry): a headless probe sampling terrain_playground.json's own height_at() across the inn's full 6x10 footprint (not just its centre and corners) found that draft's back third sitting outside the flat pad's radius-18 boundary -- the pad is a hard 0.9m plateau out to exactly 18m from centre and jumps to natural terrain by 19m (measured, no smoothstep gradient inside a metre of it), so a footprint that crosses the line reads as grass standing on the interior floor, not a subtle slope. This site's own footprint (dense-sampled, 2m x-step / 1m z-step) is flat at 0.900 everywhere, and its four rotated corners clear the workshop, wagon, well, both cottages and the practice-meadow fence run by 4m+ (rectangle-corner distance, not centre-to-centre) -- verified computationally, not eyeballed, the same discipline village_npcs.json's own Mira-position derivation used. `inn`'s recipe (building_prefabs.json) clones farmhouse_shell's massing with a real door leaf and doorway-hole colliders R7.8's shell lacked; `scripts/world/inn_interior.gd` is the third interior template, a common room (counter, two guest tables, one bed nook) rather than a stretch of the two generic house templates.
